reason: The CLI reuses the single engine assembly code in apps/host (review.decisions-2 U-15).
Clients share host connection code, settings view-models and message catalogs in packages/client (adr.0020). The X10 test compares the settings view-model item set with the config command key set.

Clients share host connection code, settings view-models and message catalogs in packages/client (adr.0020). The Plugin UI core (views/native, views/app, views/ledger) is pure code the desktop shell and the web client both use (ADR-0021 3.1, m4-plan T-VIEW).

apps/host keeps the @fresnel/host/client re-export, its tests drive the host through the client connection (the X7 settings-file test also drives the model account view-model from ./accounts), and connectServiceTransport/attachToService/bridgeStdioToService use the client socket transport and endpoint grammar (adr.0020; open: adr.0020 section 3.5 says host does not import client).

Every L3 group (packages/group-<name>, group-sdk excepted) uses the shared group definition helpers of group-sdk through its entries "." and "./testing" only (review.decisions-2 U-15). Other group paths and other group-sdk entries stay violations. The group templates (group-sdk/templates) import the same entries.

The Plugin Builder (L3.authoring.spec) is an L3 package outside the packages/group-* family. It validates and scaffolds groups with the group-sdk name rules and the drive source scan (scanDriveSource), through the entries "." and "./testing" only.
The cross-group import test runs scripts/check-layers.ts on a fixture workspace and reads its DR-02 failure (L3.group-sdk.plan G-21).
CLI scenario tests run the real fresnel process and kill it to check resume (review.decisions-2 B-06).
Restart fault tests kill a real child process at commit fault points to check resume (review.decisions-2 B-06).
Fork record checks read the fork sources for process use patterns in test/fork-records.test.ts (review.decisions-2 B-06).
Desktop shell tests run the real sidecar process and talk to it over stdio (review.decisions-2 B-06, L4.desktop.plan D1).
The approval restart test runs a real stdio host process and kills it with SIGKILL while an approval waits, then resumes in a new host (m2-plan HOST.4 A1, review.decisions-2 B-06).
